name: Dribbling
desc: Mostly moves. Crossover = dribble up or down the screen, then B with the stick the other way. Moves chain: Crossover then Double Crossover, Behind-the-Back or Shammgod.

nodes.name: Crossover
nodes.desc: Dribbling up/down the screen: B + stick the opposite way.

nodes.name: Double Crossover
nodes.desc: Right after a Crossover: B + stick opposite again to cross back.

nodes.name: Behind-the-Back
nodes.desc: Right after a Crossover: B with no stick (or the same way) to wrap it behind your back.

nodes.name: Shammgod
nodes.desc: Right after a Crossover: B + stick toward the hoop. Push it out, pull it back, explode.

nodes.name: Snatch-Back
nodes.desc: Right after Behind-the-Back: B + stick away from the hoop. Creates a wide-open window.

nodes.name: Killer Crossover
nodes.desc: Crossovers burst x1.15 harder and break ankles x1.3 more often.

nodes.name: Between-the-Legs
nodes.desc: Standing or slow: B + stick up or down.

nodes.name: In-and-Out
nodes.desc: Dribbling up/down: B + stick the SAME way. Fake the cross, keep going.

nodes.name: Spin Move
nodes.desc: B + stick toward the hoop with a defender right on you.

nodes.name: Hesi Blow-By
nodes.desc: Right after a Hesi: B + stick toward the hoop. Big burst.

nodes.name: Hesi Pull-Back
nodes.desc: Right after a Hesi: B + stick away from the hoop. Space for a jumper.

nodes.name: Step-Back
nodes.desc: B + stick away from the hoop. Creates space for a jumper.

nodes.name: Combo Artist
nodes.desc: Chain windows x1.35 and ankle-break chance x1.25.
